refnamediv.refpurpose: override maximum HP per player class

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: g_classesMaxHP overrides the maximum health points for each player class. The value is a string of 5 space-separated integers in the order: Soldier, Medic, Engineer, Field Ops, Covert Ops. A value of 0 for any class means the default HP is used. When a custom max HP is set, health regeneration caps at exactly that value without overheal.
